final_resume.summary: Computer Science graduate (2025) seeking a Software Development Engineer role to design scalable distributed systems and build robust applications using data structures, algorithms, and object-oriented design principles. Full-stack developer proficient in Java, Spring Boot, and React with demonstrated ability to deliver end-to-end solutions and write production-quality code.

projects.name: PaySplit - Group Expense Settlement
projects.description: Architected a Spring Boot REST API and React TypeScript frontend applying object-oriented design principles to split shared expenses. Integrated Razorpay payment gateway with webhook handling for multiple transaction states; wrote 40 JUnit tests ensuring code quality and containerised the application with Docker for deployment.

projects.name: Campus Library Reservations
projects.description: Designed a Java and Spring Boot service with optimised MySQL schema for study room bookings, applying data structures to eliminate double-booking conflicts. Piloted with 120 students over 2 weeks, validating end-to-end system reliability.

projects.name: Order Tracker Dashboard
projects.description: Built a React and TypeScript dashboard consuming REST APIs to track order status in real-time, deployed locally with Docker Compose for consistent development environments.

profile_improvement_tips: Gain hands-on experience with distributed systems concepts (e.g., build a multi-service architecture, study message queues like RabbitMQ or Kafka, or contribute to open-source distributed projects) to directly address the JD's emphasis on scalability.

Deepen algorithms and data structures knowledge by solving LeetCode/HackerRank problems (target 100+ medium/hard problems) and document 2-3 optimisation case studies in your projects (e.g., 'Reduced query time from O(n²) to O(n log n) using a balanced BST').

Refactor one project to demonstrate real-time capabilities (e.g., add WebSocket support to PaySplit for live expense updates, or implement a real-time notification system) to showcase end-to-end ownership of a feature from design to deployment.
final_resume.growth_note: You are a strong fresher with solid full-stack fundamentals and excellent project execution. However, the JD emphasises distributed systems and real-time systems—areas not yet visible in your profile. Prioritise these gaps before applying to accelerate your ATS score and interview readiness.
